titulo_es: A rhetorical contrast · Digital media and rhetoric

texto: A headline selects an appearance and can intensify it. It seeks omissions, comparisons and valuative words; it distinguishes a quote from the editorial voice and verifies whether the link supports the summary.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.da: Kontrasten får den foreslåede løsning til at virke enkel.
frases.es: El contraste hace que la solución propuesta parezca sencilla.
frases.en: The contrast makes the proposed solution seem simple.
